# 00090034 is Travel Mode: DSTS reads EC bit TRSA (ERAM 0xA1 bit 6), DEVS writes TRED (0xA1 bit 2).
# 00110013 / 00110014 are fan readings and 00120094 a temperature; they drift on their own.
# The IDs were chosen from the DSDT as getters with no side effects (no EC writes, no method calls),
# plus the BIOS-SMI getters 00130031 / 00130022, and 00120057 (charge limit).
